_doc: Semantic one-unit edits for nanobanana_edits.py. Each family is applied k = 1..n_units times in a chain (step k edits the output of step k-1), so one unit = one application of `prompt`. `bases` are rows (0-based) of the sorted 500Stimuli folder; null = the same 100 random bases as the controlled edits (build_imagesets.py edits). Put face stimuli in `bases` for face-specific families. The style suffix is appended to every prompt.
style_suffix: Keep it a grayscale photograph of the same single object, centred on a plain pure-white background, with the same lighting and framing. Change nothing else.

view_yaw.prompt: Rotate the object about its vertical axis by about 30 degrees, so it is seen from a slightly different viewpoint.

elongate.prompt: Make the object about 20% wider horizontally, keeping its height the same.

stripes.prompt: Add a stripe pattern to the object's surface; if it already has stripes, make them more pronounced.

add_copy.prompt: Add one more copy of the object next to the existing ones, all the same size.

face_yaw.prompt: Turn the person's head about 20 degrees further toward their left (the viewer's right). Keep the identity and expression the same.
